chung.Syllabus Name: Knowledge management system_Hệ thống quản trị tri thức
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
chung.Description:
By the end of this course Students will be able to:

a) Knowledge: (what will students know?)

• Understand knowledge and knowledge management

• Understand knowledge management models

• Understand concepts, structure, processes, techniques, and issues related to knowledge management.

• Understand knowledge management tools and applicable situations

• Know how to how to build and manage knowledge management system in the enterprise.

b) Skills: (what will students be able to do?)

• Build and manage knowledge management system in the real-time enterprise
chung.StudentTasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.
chung.Tools:
- Microsoft office for documents and presentation.

- Mindmapping tool, visual mapping tools.

- Weka software
